The '''MULTI enhanced vision system''' was a model of [[Enhanced optics suite/Legends|enhanced optics suite]] available for [[Armor/Legends|armor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The system was manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] and sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Like all enhanced optics suites, it increased its wearer's awareness of their surroundings through the addition of various [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to an armor set's helmet.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MULTI enhanced vision system was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
